name: Hiro · Brynne
title: Hiro 与 Brynne：僵尸地牢
Hiro & Brynne: Zombie Dungeon
heroTitle:
地牢里，需要真正的选择
Hiro · Brynne · 两路重制准备

A dungeon needs meaningful choices
Hiro · Brynne · remake preparation
intro: 现有作品已能找钥匙、开地穴、击败僵尸王、带宝藏逃生。重制不只把地图拉长，而是把孩子提出的节奏、选择、互动与合作重新组织；Opus 与 Astra 尚未开工。
The baseline has keys, crypt gate, Zombie King, treasure and escape. The remake should organize pacing, choices, interactions and cooperation—not only extend the map. Opus and Astra have not started.
legacy_name: 现有基线 · Zombie Dungeon V2.1

title: 把体感说成可复现的现象
Turn feelings into reproducible observations
practice: 旧Hub记录Brynne说迷宫短、互动少、朝向反和速度太快。
The old HUB attributes short maze, limited interaction, reversed facing and excessive speed feedback to Brynne.
knowledge: 设备、动作、预期、实际四项比“修一下”更可执行。
Device, action, expectation and result are more actionable than “fix it”.
expression: 我在……做……；本来以为……，实际却……。
On … I did …; I expected … but saw ….
level: 来自仓库课堂纪要的复盘；不视为完整逐字稿或独立掌握证明。
Retrospective from repository lesson notes, not a complete transcript or proof of independent mastery.

title: 区分完成清单和真正好玩
Distinguish a feature checklist from enjoyable play
practice: 道具、门、Boss和结局齐全，仍可能主要重复走路打怪。
Items, gate, boss and ending can all exist while most play is still walk-and-fight.
knowledge: 决策密度、节奏、奖励与复玩动机需要单独设计。
Choices, pacing, rewards and replay motivation need deliberate design.
expression: 这里让玩家在什么之间选择？选择不同，结果怎样不同？
What alternatives does the player choose between, and how do outcomes differ?
level: 来自仓库课堂纪要的复盘；不视为完整逐字稿或独立掌握证明。
Retrospective from repository lesson notes, not a complete transcript or proof of independent mastery.

title: 共同地图不是完整合作机制
Sharing a map is not a full co-op mechanic
practice: 原型已经能共享地图；旧Hub明确合作规则深度不足。
The prototype shares a map; the old HUB identifies limited cooperative depth.
knowledge: 共享状态和合作设计分别验收；单机本地适配不代表互联网多人服务。
Test shared-state correctness separately from co-op design; local solo is not internet hosting.
expression: 我的动作怎样改变伙伴的情况？只靠自己能不能完成？
How does my action change my teammate’s situation? Can one person finish alone?
level: 来自仓库课堂纪要的复盘；不视为完整逐字稿或独立掌握证明。
Retrospective from repository lesson notes, not a complete transcript or proof of independent mastery.

title: 一个参数会改变整个体验
One parameter can change the experience
practice: 速度、敌人追击、生命与奖励在同一个地牢里互相影响。
Speed, enemy pursuit, health and rewards interact in the same dungeon.
knowledge: 系统思维与控制变量；需要对照而不是一次改十项后猜原因。
Systems thinking and controlled comparison, not changing ten things and guessing.
expression: 只改这一项，再用同样路线测试，我们怎样知道它更好了？
Change one thing and test the same route: how will we know it improved?
level: 来自仓库课堂纪要的复盘；不视为完整逐字稿或独立掌握证明。
Retrospective from repository lesson notes, not a complete transcript or proof of independent mastery.
